name: forensic-software-auditor
description: A rigorous, evidence-led workflow for comprehensive software repository audits, coverage tracking, prioritized remediation, and GitHub issue proposals.

interface.longDescription: Audit software repositories systematically across code quality, architecture, security, performance, testing, dependencies, configuration, deployment, data integrity, accessibility, UX, and documentation. Maintain a verifiable file inventory, distinguish confirmed findings from hypotheses, and produce prioritized remediation and GitHub issue proposals without modifying the project during the initial audit.
defaultPrompt: Start a forensic, evidence-led audit of my repository. Begin with Phase 1: inventory only, and do not modify anything.
Continue the repository audit from its recorded coverage and inspect the next controlled block of files.
Prepare a prioritized remediation plan and GitHub issue proposals from verified audit findings. Do not create issues or modify code.
